subject: th-cont
title: TH.CONT.------(R)TH.CONT.
description: Diagram in CMBA-7, on the page where Braxton outlines the second degree of extended functionalism — 'the vibrational implications of collected participation in alternative creativity'. (C)TH-CONT — the *concept* of thrust continuance — is crossed with (R)TH-CONT — the *reality* of thrust continuance: a uniquely self-referential crossing where the same term appears with both prefixes, forcing the reader to ask what thrust-continuance-as-concept and thrust-continuance-as-real actually look like together. C-CONT (composite continuance) feeds (C)TH-CONT. (C)TH-CONT outputs to T-C-IMP (time continuum implications), which is also fed by AFI (affinity insight) and AFL-DY (affinity dynamics), and which loops back to (C)TH-CONT and outputs to PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics). INFO-DOC (information documentation) also feeds (C)TH-CONT, which outputs to INFO-DE-B (a diagram-only term, likely 'information determination basis'). LK-IMP (linkage implications) feeds (C)TH-CONT. (R)TH-CONT is connected via the diagram's title only — its specific edges aren't in the relationships list, suggesting Braxton wanted the *crossing* itself (concept vs reality of the same term) to be the structural argument. Structural claim: the concept of thrust continuance is over-determined upstream (composite continuance, affinity insight, information documentation, affinity dynamics, linkage implications all feed it through time-continuum implications), and its only direct outputs are projectional dynamics and information-determination-basis. The reality of thrust continuance is what's *outside* this diagram's explicit edges — implicit in the music's actualization, not specifiable as another node.
